parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The first record is production code in the `DebugPanel` package. Extracting the shared `DebugMetricsProvider.handleDisplayLinkTick` implementation to a common location would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to demonstration-app semantics. The duplication is intentional: the sample app maintains its own local copy of the display-link tick handler so it can evolve independently of the production panel.
